unintendedEffectNote: ZERO writes outside the stated purpose. Every mutation observed on the fork maps to one of the five coupled changes or to their declared supporting steps. No unrelated contract was touched, no ownership moved, no config reset to a constructor default, no off-chain file written outside scripts/snapshots/ (progress file confirmed absent after the preview run). The findings below are about GUARD STRENGTH, VERIFICATION COVERAGE and READ-VS-REPLAY semantics - not about the script doing something it did not say it would do.
toolingCaveats: State-diff capture was by explicit before/after reads emitted by the script's own console.log stream plus independent cast reads at the pin block, not by a --json state-diff dump. Writes outside the script's instrumented targets would be unobserved; however the full external-call surface was enumerated from source (2,171 lines read in full), so the mutation set above is source-complete rather than trace-complete.

The dry run was executed against a LOCAL ANVIL FORK pinned at 25659373 rather than live RPC, so that the run is reproducible and the pin matches the closure manifest. The npm key uses --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET directly (chain tip); behaviour is identical modulo block.
